name: Satoshi Sprototo

cast: CAST: lean head back slightly and puff the huge red-lipped cheeks; roll shoulders forward with both elbows tucked BACK and lips purse; forceful open-mouth SPIT to RIGHT with a sharp forward neck and torso snap, both hands still near ribs, never a palm shot; chin lowers and huge smile returns while weight settles. defeat: DEFEAT START: startled narrowed eyes widen while the enormous red smile sags; one palm rises to the mouth as both knees buckle; hips collapse backward with both arms balancing; roll onto left side, huge head to LEFT and feet to RIGHT, collar attached. appearanceRule: Preserve the same costume and face across every frame. Same-hue limited palette shading; no white clothing patches, text, floating effects, detached accessories or additional actors.
unlockRule: Defeat this fighter in its campaign encounter to recruit for P1 play.
